title: Allow full unit validation to finish after slow runner setup
acceptance: Full unit jobs retain ffmpeg, Chromium, audio hydration, the existing shard commands and all assertions, with a bounded time limit that accommodates observed slow package setup.
Required CI and independent review pass on the final candidate; the previously missing full unit shard is checked on the released tree or a clearly identified equivalent candidate.

evidence.note: On released 2cbae518, shards 3 and 4 exceeded the 15-minute job limit during Ubuntu package setup, before unit tests ran. Retry of shard 3 passed 2166 tests with 43 skipped; shard 4 again timed out during Chromium dependency setup. Successful browser and other unit results remain separate.

activity.summary: Claimed the narrow full-unit timeout correction after two observed setup timeouts; preserve real Chromium and ffmpeg checks.

summary: Increase only the full-unit job timeout from 15 to 30 minutes. Hosted candidate validation remains pending; this does not alter deployment, browser jobs or human acceptance.
